title: stelis velaticaulis
intro: Stelis velaticaulis, commonly known as Velvet Stelis, is a species of orchid native to Central America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Stelis velaticaulis include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
